title: 多模态智能体框架基础与前沿综述：技术与应用
summary: 该综述系统分析了多模态对智能体框架核心模块（感知、推理、规划、记忆、行动）的影响，提出模态中心分类法，梳理从文本智能体到多模态框架的演进，涵盖机器人、GUI/Web导航、多媒体生成与编辑、长视频理解等应用，并讨论效率与可扩展性权衡。
summary_en: This survey systematically analyzes the impact of multimodality on core agentic framework modules (perception, reasoning, planning, memory, action), proposes a modality-centric taxonomy, traces evolution from text-centric to multimodal frameworks, covers applications like robotics, GUI/Web navigation, multimedia generation, long-form video understanding, and discusses efficiency-scalability trade-offs.
